product_one_liner.value: Harmony Healthcare IT helps healthcare organizations move, archive and securely manage patient, employee and business records.
product_one_liner.notes: The company's job posting describes moving and storing patient, employee and business records for healthcare organizations; the investment announcement describes its secure healthcare data-management platform: https://ats.rippling.com/harmony-healthcare-it/jobs/eb4b0a36-e350-46f0-806a-27a888e1c7b1 and https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes standard, enterprise and SaaS pricing models, which qualifies even without published dollar prices: https://www.harmonyhit.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Magnolia case study confirms its selection of Harmony for legacy-data management. The Parkview story explicitly confirms selection of HealthData Archiver. Sources: https://www.harmonyhit.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Magnolia-Regional-Case-Study.pdf and https://www.harmonyhit.com/resources/health-data-management-parkview-health-aims-to-enhance-efficiency-with-archiving-solutions/ | named_customers.0: The case study identifies Magnolia Regional Health Center and confirms its selection of Harmony for legacy-data management. | named_customers.1: The customer story names Parkview Health and confirms its selection of HealthData Archiver.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company record lists 235 employees, which falls in the requested 201-500 band. LinkedIn counts are approximate: https://linkedin.com/company/harmony-healthcare-it

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly labels its South Bend address as headquarters: https://www.cience.com/company/harmony-healthcare-it/-7841860060680087284 | hq_country: The company profile labels the South Bend, Indiana, United States address as headquarters: https://www.cience.com/company/harmony-healthcare-it/-7841860060680087284

founded_year.notes: The company's anniversary announcement explicitly states that Harmony Healthcare IT was founded in 2006: https://www.harmonyhit.com/harmony-healthcare-it-marks-20-years-of-healthcare-data-transformation-and-innovation

eng_blog.notes: The technical-category index shows migration advice, M&A guidance and a customer story, rather than two engineer-authored posts explaining how Harmony's products are built. This supports false under the requested definition, with some uncertainty about archive completeness: https://www.harmonyhit.com/category/technical

public_docs.notes: The public Blue Elm tutorial collection contains several substantive product guides, including Conversions, DR Dashboard, DR Auditor and OpenGate, with technical instructions rather than a single FAQ: https://www.harmonyhit.com/blue-elm-resources-types/tutorial

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete six-role board lists Data Conversion Interface Analyst, Systems Analyst, AWS DevOps Engineer, Associate Business Development Director, Business Development Director and Solutions Analyst. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title: https://ats.rippling.com/harmony-healthcare-it/jobs

model_provider.notes: Unknown: the reviewed product descriptions, technical tutorials, AI resource, security/Trust Center FAQs and privacy vendor disclosures did not identify an AI model or provider actually used by the product. ClearWay is described as AI-powered without naming its provider, while the privacy policy names website-marketing vendors rather than model providers. Sources include https://www.harmonyhit.com/harmony-healthcare-it-launches-clearway-to-revolutionize-clinical-data-abstraction-and-registry-submission-process, https://trust.harmonyhit.com/certifications and https://www.harmonyhit.com/privacy/

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center explicitly lists SOC 2 and HIPAA. HITRUST and PIPEDA are excluded because they are outside the five requested frameworks: https://trust.harmonyhit.com/certifications | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center explicitly names HIPAA.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest funding record labels the round PE, and the announcement identifies the investor as private-equity firm Novacap. Accordingly, the stage is private equity, not none: https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management | funding_date: The latest recorded round is dated November 28, 2023, matching Novacap's announcement; normalized to the requested month format, this is 2023-11: https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management | funding_amount_usd: The latest recorded round has no disclosed amount, and Novacap's announcement describes a significant investment without stating a dollar figure. The amount therefore remains null: https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded investment is the November 28, 2023 Novacap transaction, before the eighteen-month window; no newer round was found: https://novacapcorp.com/news/harmony-healthcare-it-partners-with-novacap-to-accelerate-innovation-and-growth-in-healthcare-data-management

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The complete job board has no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account-executive title. Its two sales openings are director-level business-development roles, which do not meet the requested title criteria: https://ats.rippling.com/harmony-healthcare-it/jobs

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated substantive product launch located was ClearWay on February 25, 2025, before the six-month window. No newer qualifying launch was found in the reviewed announcement history. The later digital-launch announcement describes a website and messaging redesign, not a new product. Sources: https://www.prweb.com/releases/harmony-healthcare-it-launches-clearway-to-revolutionize-clinical-data-abstraction-and-registry-submission-process-302383751.html and https://www.prweb.com/releases/harmony-healthcare-it-unveils-digital-launch-to-reflect-commitment-to-optimize-health-data-management-and-support-patient-care-302489725.html

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The May 12, 2026 announcement names Brian Liddell as CEO effective April 30, 2026, succeeding Tom Liddell, who transitions to chairman. The CEO change falls within the requested twelve-month window: https://www.harmonyhit.com/harmony-healthcare-it-announces-ceo-transition

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The business-development posting explicitly describes daily pipeline work using Sugar CRM. The privacy policy explicitly states that the website uses Act-On. Salesforce is excluded because it appears only as preferred prior experience.
